## Schengen visa application draft for P1

Complete each `NEEDS-YOU` entry on your device. Where two rows share a field number, put the applicable entries together in that field.

| Field | Entry | What to check or complete |
|---|---|---|
| B01 · Surname | RAGHUNATHAN | |
| B02 · Surname at birth | NEEDS-YOU | Confirm your surname at birth and any former family names. |
| B03 · First name | VIKRAM | Enter your given names in the order shown in your passport. |
| B03 · Middle name | ANAND | Include it in the same field if it appears among your passport’s given names. |
| B04 · Date of birth | 22/11/1983 | After the value is restored, write it in day-month-year order. |
| B05 · Place of birth | PUNE, MAHARASHTRA | |
| B06 · Country of birth | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your country of birth. |
| B07 · Current nationality | Indian | |
| B07 · Nationality at birth | NEEDS-YOU | Complete only if different from your current nationality. |
| B07 · Other nationalities | NEEDS-YOU | Enter any other nationalities you hold. |
| B08 · Sex | Female ☐ / Male ☑ | Select Male. |
| B09 · Civil status | Married | |
| B10 · Parental authority or guardian | Leave blank | This field applies to minors. |
| B11 · National identity number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your national identity number locally if applicable. |
| B12 · Travel document type | NEEDS-YOU | Check your passport’s category and tick the matching box. |
| B13 · Travel document number | Z4827163 | |
| B14 · Date of issue | 05/06/2019 | If the form requires a different date format, reformat it by hand after the value is restored. |
| B15 · Valid until | 04-06-2029 | |
| B16 · Issued by | India | |
| B17–B18 · Qualifying family member | Leave blank if inapplicable | Complete these fields only if you have a qualifying family member under the form’s instructions. |
| B19 · Home address | 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom | |
| B19 · Email address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your email address alongside your home address. |
| B19 · Telephone | +44 7700 900123 | |
| B20 · Residence outside country of nationality | Yes. UK residence permit. | |
| B20 · Permit number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the permit or equivalent reference number locally. |
| B20 · Permit valid until | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the expiry date of your UK residence permission. |
| B21 · Current occupation | Software engineer | |
| B22 · Employer | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your employer’s name, address and telephone number. |
| B23 · Purpose | Business | |
| B24 · Additional information | Attending a trade fair in Munich, Germany, from 8 to 13 March 2027. | |
| B25 · Main destination | Germany | Add any other Schengen destinations on your itinerary if applicable. |
| B26 · First entry | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the country where you first enter the Schengen area. Use Germany if you enter there first. |
| B27 · Number of entries | NEEDS-YOU | Select single, two or multiple entries based on your planned border crossings. |
| B28 · Intended arrival | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your planned Schengen arrival date. Use 08-03-2027 if you arrive on the first fair day. |
| B29 · Intended departure | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your planned Schengen departure date. Use 13-03-2027 if you depart on the last fair day. |
| B30 · Previous fingerprints | Yes | Your fingerprints were taken in 2023. Leave the exact date blank. Enter the visa sticker number locally if known. |
| B31 · Final-destination entry permit | Leave blank if inapplicable | If your itinerary requires an onward entry permit, enter its issuer and validity dates. |
| B32 · Inviting person or accommodation | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your inviting person’s surname and given name, or the name of your hotel or other accommodation. |
| B33 · Inviting person or accommodation contact | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the address, email and telephone number. |
| B34 · Inviting company or organisation | NEEDS-YOU | Enter its name and address if an organisation is inviting you. |
| B35 · Inviting organisation contact | NEEDS-YOU | If B34 applies, enter the contact person’s surname, given name, address, telephone and email, plus the organisation’s telephone number. |
| B36 · Who covers your costs | By a sponsor | Your employer is paying. Select “referred to in field 30 or 31” if your employer is already listed there. Otherwise select “other” and enter its name. |
| B36 · Sponsor name and means of support | NEEDS-YOU | Supply your employer’s name if using “other” and tick the means of support it actually provides. |
| B37–B38 · Person completing the form | Leave blank if you complete it yourself | If someone else completes it, enter their name, address, email and telephone number. |
| B39 · Place and date | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the place and date when you sign. |
| B40 · Signature | NEEDS-YOU | Sign in the applicant signature field. Leave the guardian signature line blank if inapplicable. |
